en.html:
HanaeShishiku!? ...Didi!
KanaeGh...!
ShishikuThree minutes and fifty seconds behind you. That long I have been following. Nothing you noticed, akal ki andhi...?
ShishikuThat evil eye of yours remains very selective. What ought to be seen, that only it cannot see. Not a trace of the greater cause, not a trace of loyalty. Unnecessary things, meanwhile, it sees very nicely...
ShishikuA low creature's eye. Useless! Ootori blood you carry, at least that much. Then where is the eye of a sovereign?
Kanae...Kh. A sovereign's... eye?
KanaeWith that... I could have avoided being caught by the freak coming off the wall? Moving so nicely that even a newt would feel inadequate? Very useful eye, then...!
ShishikuBakwaas. I measured the distance. One move, and I could reach you. That much only.
ShishikuNeither time nor opponent deserves warrior's courtesy here...!
KanaeAchha... then. Why not kill me and finish the matter...?
ShishikuBelieve me, sending you to the next world cannot happen soon enough. But—
ShishikuSomething came out of this mouth that cannot simply be allowed to pass.
Kanae...Did it, now...?
ShishikuNot your little revenge game. Let us be clear on that. You want my life? Haan, keep trying. As much as you like...
ShishikuKeep trying, till shame comes to you! Blood of the Ootori main line, and all you can see is your own little revenge! My head, I should hand over to such a small-minded specimen!?

ja.html:
花枝「獅子吼!? 　……姉さん！」
香奈枝「ぐ……！」
獅子吼「三分と五〇秒前から背後に従ついていたわ。 　気付かなかったのか間抜けめ……」
獅子吼「貴様の邪眼は相変わらず、見るべきものに 限って見えんらしいな。 　大義も信義も、いっかな宿さん。そのくせ 余計なものはよく映す……」
獅子吼「愚にもつかぬ下衆の眼だ！ 　卑しくも大鳥の家系に連なる者が、何ゆえ 王者の眼を持たん！」
香奈枝「……っ。 　王者の……眼？」
香奈枝「それがあれば……イモリも顔負けの動きで 壁から・・・襲ってくる変態に捕まらなくて済んだ のかしら？ 　重宝だこと……ッ」
獅子吼「抜かせ。 　貴様に一手で届く間合を計っただけの事だ」
獅子吼「武人の作法を守るべき時でも相手でもなか ろうしな……！」
香奈枝「あら……なら。 　どうして、さっさと殺してしまわないのか、 しら……？」
獅子吼「俺とて一刻も早く貴様を冥途につかせたい。 　が――」
獅子吼「この口が、聞き捨てならぬ事をほざいた」
香奈枝「……さぁ……？」
獅子吼「言っておくが、貴様の仇討ごっこの事では ない。 　俺の命を狙う？　ああ、好きなだけ狙うが いい……」
獅子吼「大鳥嫡流の血を享うけながら、己一身の復讐 しか眼に入らぬ、その狭量を恥じぬかぎりは いつまでもな！ 　そんな小人に俺が首をやると思うか!!」

en.html:
Kanae............
ShishikuLady Hanae's words are also no concern... Use me for Yamato, then throw me away. Hearing she has that much intention was a relief, actually.
ShishikuThat much ambition should be there. Otherwise even a temporary bow from this Shishiku would be wasted.
Hanae...
ShishikuHer eyes see a good deal further than yours! Beyond the end of her own nose, for a start. For discarding you and retaining Lady Hanae, the previous lord deserves credit. In that one matter only.
ShishikuNot nearly enough credit to cancel the crime of rebelling against the lord before him...
Kanae...Kh... Then... what is it...?
ShishikuWhat you said before that. ...Yuhi sir's murder in Kamakura. Do you know something about it?
Kanae............
ShishikuI thought it was your doing. Kill the rightful successor, protect little sister's position. Your two-paisa cleverness could certainly produce that.
ShishikuThat suspicion still stands. But... for the moment, I shall give your account a hearing.
Hanae...
ShishikuSpeak, Kanae. What do you know?
KanaeYou are asking... the wrong person, are you not? For such things, there is the police...
ShishikuKamakura City Police? They have not even announced the incident. For the investigation, they say... Very strange. Something is smelling.
ShishikuI meant to squeeze an answer out of them in due course. ...But if I make you talk now, that trouble can be saved, no?
ShishikuSeedha bol. No dodging, you vixen.

ja.html:
香奈枝「…………」
獅子吼「花枝様のお言葉も、気にしてはおらん……。 　大和のために俺を利用した挙句切り捨てる 肚がおありと聞いて、むしろ安堵したほどだ」
獅子吼「そのくらいの雄図あってこそ、この獅子吼 が仮初めにも頭を下げるに足る」
花枝「……」
獅子吼「鼻先の物事しか見られぬ貴様より、よほど 優れた眼をお持ちだ！ 　貴様を捨てて花枝様を残した先代は、その 点に限ってのみ評価できる」
獅子吼「先々代に叛いた罪を帳消しにするには到底 足らんがな……」
香奈枝「……、……っく。 　なら……何を……？」
獅子吼「その前の話だ。 　……貴様、鎌倉で雄飛様が殺害された件に ついて何か知っているのか？」
香奈枝「…………」
獅子吼「俺は貴様の仕業だと思っていた。 　妹の地位を守るために正当な後継者を殺す ……貴様の浅知恵ならやりかねん」
獅子吼「今でもその疑いは解いていない。が…… 　ひとまずは貴様の話に耳を傾けてやろう」
花枝「……」
獅子吼「言え、香奈枝。 　貴様は何を知っているのだ」
香奈枝「訊ねる相手が……違いまして、よ？ 　そんなこと、警察にでも」
獅子吼「鎌倉市警か。奴らは事件の公表すらしてい ない。捜査のための措置という話だが……。 　不可解だな。どうも臭い」
獅子吼「いずれ締め上げてみるつもりでいた。 　……しかし、それもいま貴様を吐かせれば 省ける手間なのだろう？」
獅子吼「誤魔化すな、女狐」

ShishikuWho killed Yuhi sir?
Kanae...Once you have... heard that, what do you propose to do?
ShishikuWhat else is there? Wherever the culprit hides, I find them. The head comes off by my own hand.
KanaeHuh... hehehe...!
ShishikuWhat is amusing you?
KanaeThen... nahi. That answer disqualifies you. I cannot tell you...
Shishiku—Kanae.

Ootori Soldier GYour Excellency!?
Ootori Soldier HTh... this is—
Shishiku...Late. Intruders roaming freely, and you fellows were where? Doing what, exactly?
Ootori Soldier HSir, actually— The communications have become a little mixed up...
Ootori Soldier GBesides Lady Kanae, someone else seems to be creating diversions—
Shishiku...Leave it. This will be finished shortly anyway.
ShishikuLeave two here. The rest will attend Lady Hanae. Her wish is to wait quietly in the inner rooms until this worthless commotion is over.
Ootori Soldier HYes, sir!
Ootori Soldier GMy lady, we shall accompany you.

大鳥兵士Ｇ「閣下!?」
大鳥兵士Ｈ「こ……これは」
獅子吼「……遅いわ。 　貴様ら、侵入者を放って、今まで何処で何 をしていた」
大鳥兵士Ｈ「は、その―― 　いささか、連絡が錯綜しており」
大鳥兵士Ｇ「香奈枝様の他にも、撹乱を行っている者が いるようで――」
獅子吼「……まぁいい。 　どうせ、もう片が付く」
獅子吼「二人残して、余の者は花枝様に随身せよ。 　この下らぬ騒動が収まるのを、奥で静かに 待たれるとの思し召しだ」
大鳥兵士Ｈ「はっ」
大鳥兵士Ｇ「御館様、お供仕ります」
